title: The Poison Pill Method
summary: Xiao Yan holds Little Fairy Doctor through the poison and uses his Heavenly Flame to stop the Woeful Poison Body from spreading. She agrees to trust him and orders all three sects out of the Jia Ma Empire. At a later meeting Xiao Yan learns the Hall of Souls set her on him, and she agrees to look away while he kills Yan Luo Tian and the Three Elders of Mulan. He describes the Poison Pill Method, which needs the core of a Rank Seven Sky Poison Dragon Scorpion Beast, three Heavenly Flames and Bodhisattva Body Transformation Saliva, and she gives him a jade piece to crush when the attack starts. At the Snakemen Clan, the First Elder tells him Medusa has under two years to live unless the soul of the Heaven Swallowing Python and the leftover Fallen Heart Flame energy are balanced. Xiao Yan promises a Heaven Soul Blood Fusing Pill within two years, and the Snakemen Clan joins the Yan Alliance.
